config.description: H1/H2/H4 on L2 (10x10, 3 robots, 2 targets, shared map): IPPO vs MAPPO vs Random, 5 training seeds each, final checkpoint, held-out test and structured (G2) maps, stochastic evaluation primary. Budget and H2 metric set from the Phase 6 validation-only pilot (docs/EXPERIMENTS.md §4/§6, D1-D3): L2 saturates by ~125k steps, so 1M is used instead of the spec's 3M, H2 is decided on censored steps rather than success (which saturates for both algorithms), and the AUC window is the first 245,760 steps rather than the whole budget.

ippo.statement: H1 supported for IPPO: test success exceeds Random by +0.564 (95% Welch CI [+0.515, +0.613]).

mappo.statement: H1 supported for MAPPO: test success exceeds Random by +0.565 (95% Welch CI [+0.516, +0.614]).

H2.statement: H2 not supported: no detectable difference between MAPPO and IPPO in censored steps-to-completion (MAPPO − IPPO -0.315, 95% Welch CI [-1.802, +1.172]; Hedges' g -0.28). With 5 vs 5 seeds the power is low, so this is not evidence of equivalence.

H3.statement: Differences in behaviour were observed; evidence of learned coordination is inconclusive (§24.4).

H4.statement: H4 (descriptive, no threshold): IPPO keeps 0.83 of its test success on the structured maps (95% CI [0.72, 0.93]); MAPPO keeps 0.82 of its test success on the structured maps (95% CI [0.79, 0.85]); Random keeps 0.33 of its test success on the structured maps (95% CI [0.20, 0.46]).
